item.title: Dozens of former Tyson workers in Lexington relocate to other facilities, union says
item.description: LEXINGTON, Neb. (KLKN-TV) — Dozens of former employees at Tyson’s plant in Lexington have begun to relocate, according to the union that represents hourly employees. A union spokesperson said that the former workers are being relocated to other Nebraska facilities.
